name: aviator-intelligence
description: Local-first research, simulation and analytics dashboard for the crash-style game Aviator. Research and simulation only; no real-money execution.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && npm run build --workspace @aviator/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/shared/dist apps/server/dist apps/web/dist coverage packages/shared/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/server/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
